finding: FW-7 reply-offer context is not carried through location.state navigation to ServiceDetailScreen when a reply card navigates, so the preConfirmed booking CTA cannot wire to the offer details.
evidence: ServiceDetailScreen.jsx line 46–57 reads replyOffer from location.state?.responseId, but ProfileScreen.jsx has no code that sets location.state when navigating from a reply card to /service/:serviceId — the reply context is never passed forward.
fix: ProfileScreen (or the reply card component that calls navigate) must pass {responseId, requestId, offerCents} in the location.state second argument to navigate() when the user taps a reply card's service link, so ServiceDetailScreen receives replyOffer populated and renders 'Book · $X' wired to that offer.
